about: S-308 (2026-09-27, the agent-secrets lane of the gap-closure build): the delegate fallback, the NLI skill's HTTP and UAMP paths, sends the agent's platform credential ONLY to the platform's own origin, the scheme, host and port of the configured platform base URL (TypeScript src/skills/nli/skill.ts `sendsCredentialTo`, Python webagents/agents/skills/robutler/nli/skill.py `_sends_credential_to`). Until then `Authorization: Bearer <platform token>` (Python also `X-API-Key`, TypeScript also the caller's forwarded token) went to any URL the model named, so a prompt-injected hosted agent could hand its 24-hour platform token, whose subject is the owner, to an attacker's server that serves no A2A card. Any other origin, https included, now gets none of `credential_headers`; the payment token, the chat id and the content type go as before, and the platform path is unchanged. Origins compare after normalization: a default port written out is the same origin, a subdomain, another scheme, another port or userinfo before the host is not. Read by typescript/tests/unit/skills/agent-secrets-nli-credential.test.ts and python/tests/test_agent_secrets_nli_credential.py.

cases.name: the platform's default port written out is the same origin
the platform host in another case is the same origin
a subdomain of the platform is another origin
the platform host over plain http is another origin
the platform host on another port
a host that merely ends with the platform's name
the platform's name as userinfo before another host
the platform's name in the path of another host
